concept: IAM: cross-account ExternalId vs confused deputy
tests: Which trust policy element protects against the confused deputy problem when a third-party SaaS accesses customer accounts.
expected: Condition sts:ExternalId in the customer role's trust policy — a shared secret between customer and provider. Triggers: "third party / SaaS provider", "cross-account access", "confused deputy".
why_not: aws:SourceVpc — VPC origin; aws:RequestedRegion — region; kms:ViaService — KMS service context; none addresses third-party trust.
